name: sim-scholar-qwen3-4b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507: 36 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A rl of Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, not a new base model: same config.json, same 4.411 parameters. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-07-10. CAVEAT: step 120 was chosen AFTER inspecting the test-set curve, and the card itself says the result is 'diagnostic rather than an unbiased final benchmark'. n=75 on the full-text-available LitQA2 subset, single run, no CI. Transfer to the AstaBench paper-finder task stayed flat, so the gain is specific to QA-style literature questions and does not indicate general agentic ability. Safetensors index totals 4,411,424,256 parameters against the base's 4,022,468,096. The delta is exactly 388,956,160 = vocab_size 151936 x hidden_size 2560, i.e. the tied embedding matrix stored a second time as an untied lm_head - the config is otherwise identical. So params_b records what is on disk (4.411B) while active_params_b stays at the base's 4.0B, which is the compute-relevant figure. No extra capability is implied by the larger count. FLOPs per active token set to 8e+09 (= 2 * active_params_b * 1e9, SCHEMA.md:543) rather than the generator's 6e9 coefficient, which is a 3x overstatement still live in tools/mk_finetune_record.py:251; value overwritten from base record arithmetic.

benchmarks.name: LitQA2 full-text subset accuracy
benchmarks.config: Card Evaluation table, AstaBench tool surface, n=75, no few-shot setting printed; base Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 0.173 in the same table. Checkpoint is global step 120, selected post hoc off this test curve, so the card calls it diagnostic.
